names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 14 ноября ст. ст., name page 9368, «Николай (Виноградов), протоиерей, сщмч.», with the grade word and the rank word left off. The day's own line declines the name to «Николая» and gives it without a surname. The corpus already holds this exact form on `nicholas-vinogradov`, a priest and confessor dead in 1931 whom the same calendar keeps on the Julian 4 ноября; the fold is deliberate and the two are told apart by day, by year, by grade and by slug.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of the line it names him in on 14 ноября ст. ст. The calendar carries no life page, so the year it prints at the end of that line is the whole of what is recorded here. No day, no place and no manner of death are given, and none is inferred.
